border: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied square spaceship UV atlas. Change ONLY the thin red-and-white perimeter caution border around the rectangular herringbone-arrow hatch near the top-left of the image (approximately x111..400, y58..174 in the 1254-square atlas). Make the perimeter border an even, consistent narrow thickness on all four sides. Red and off-white sections must alternate regularly all the way around the perimeter, with similarly sized short sections and sensible corner transitions. No long unbroken white runs. Preserve mild fine chipped-paint flecks and the exact weathered red/off-white colour character. Keep the same hatch position, outline, outer footprint and underlying hardware. CRITICAL: keep every central herringbone arrow, dark hatch inset, bolt and surrounding hull detail unchanged. Do not alter any other part of the atlas, windows, hull panels, decals, machinery or palette. Flat unlit game texture with no added reflections. No new graphics, redesign, labels or layout.
